admission.justification: Realized in the crossing report writer and the sync transaction emission gate, and five tests pin the counts, the summary view, the emission predicate and the journaled carry, so a future report change that drops a population fails before it lands.

applicability: Every crossing sync and ordinary converted-line sync result.
conditions: Any nonzero diagnostic population persists a report, even on a clean merge with no conflict.
exclusions: Clean merges with zero diagnostics, which write no report.

evidence: Rationale: _needs_crossing_report persists a report for conflicts, conversions, renumbering, kept evidence lines and skipped cards, so nonzero diagnostics survive even clean merges; successful_crossings attaches the same crossing_summary view (report identity plus alignment counts) that resolution responses carry, with no new payload contract. Observed: test_the_report_seam_keeps_every_nonzero_alignment_population (all six populations), test_apply_writes_a_report_for_evidence_only_and_skip_only_plans (operation seam with mocks), test_successful_sync_carries_the_journaled_report_and_counts, and the real-sync integration asserting reportPath plus renumberedReferences 1 on a clean renumber merge.

statement: Rule 8 reporting: the crossing report and the sync result summary count aligned cards, renumbered references, kept evidence lines and skipped cards with reasons, on resolution and success responses alike
